question:
Select the option that has the same relation between the words as the relation between the words of the given pair.

Iran : Riyal
solution:
The currency of Iran is Riyal.

Similarly;

The currency of Russia is Ruble.

Hence, **"Russia : Ruble"** is the correct answer.
